payload.title: Projectile Flight Physics (발사체 공통 비행 물리)
payload.user_technical_boundary: PFP-P0-02 Technical PASS is preserved. PFP-P0-03 Reticle semantics are RESOLVED. USER directly confirmed Cannon gravity-on trajectory, Guided Missile locked-target guidance, and BurnedOut natural gravity-drop behavior. Rocket gravity-on / launch-axis-stabilization was not visually re-observed; USER explicitly waived that observation as low priority, so it is not recorded as USER observed PASS and instead relies on the preserved PFP-P0-02 Technical PASS. Vehicle Selection HUD lock-target presentation improvement is deferred as a separate non-blocking HUD task.

provenance.resolution_basis: USER confirmed stable Vehicle Target Lock behavior after Production input retarget correction and Basic Sensor operational-range correction, then confirmed the Guided Missile actually steers toward the locked vehicle. Cannon gravity-on and BurnedOut natural drop were already USER PASS. Rocket visual trajectory review was explicitly waived by USER rather than falsely promoted to observed PASS. PFP-P0-03 is therefore USER ACCEPTED and CF-FQ-056 closes completed. Cleanup removed the one-time BasicSensorOperationalRangeMigration Automation after persisted Sensor values were confirmed, leaving no permanent tuning gate; CFSensorActiveScanTests.cpp returned to worktree diff0.
